title: Best Time to Buy And Sell Stock With Cooldown
description:
Each day has a stock price in prices. You may hold at most one share at a time, buying before you sell. After selling, the next day is a mandatory rest day on which you cannot buy. Return the largest total profit obtainable; you may skip any day and make any number of completed trades.

A sale earns that day's price minus the purchase price. There is no fee and no requirement to trade; returning zero is valid when all trades lose money. Track whether you finish a day holding, resting after a sale, or free to buy.

Example 1:

Input: prices = [1,2,3,0,2]
Output: 3

Buy at 1, sell at 2, rest on day 3, then buy at 0 and sell at 2: profit 3.

Example 2:

Input: prices = [2,1,4]
Output: 3

Buy at 1 and sell at 4 for profit 3.

Example 3:

Input: prices = []
Output: 0

With no trading days there is no profit.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= prices.length <= 500
  • 0 <= prices[i] <= 1000
  • Only one share can be held at a time.
